revati ramaDvamasmin yonavasmin gosWesmi.s: revatI ramaDvamasmin yonAvasmin gozWe'smiM loke'smin kzaye (VSKh। asmin yonA asmin gozWe'smin kzaye'smiM loke; TS. asmin gozWe'smin kzaye'smin yonO; MS.KS.Ap। asmin yonA asmin gozWe)
